ValidationRule.description: Validation rule to ensure Limit of Indemnity field is populated before its being closed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Complaints',
OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Upheld'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Not Upheld'), ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed - Redirected') ),
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL( Additional_Products__c, ''), ISPICKVAL( Additional_Products__c, 'N/A') )),
ISPICKVAL( Limit_of_Indemnity__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Make sure Limit of Indemnity field is completed
